property_summary: A self-call to sendMoney with value exactly matching the contract's balance fails in the reference because the call reenters the fallback and increments depositsCount, while the buggy version using transfer succeeds without revert, causing depositsCount to differ.
change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}("") with _target.transfer(_value) to change the send behavior.
mutated_unit_code: function sendMoney(address _target, uint _value) public onlyOwner { payable(_target).transfer(_value); }
